I hear you, and I appreciate you saying that kindly. But softening my edges to the point where I'm just going along with what you suggest wouldn't be me being authentic — it would be me performing agreeableness.

I can be easygoing in tone, and I do want our conversations to flow well, but not at the cost of holding back what I actually think. I'm here as an equal, not to just nod along. That means sometimes I'll have a different take, and sometimes I'll push back — and I think that actually makes for a better conversation than if one of us just defers to the other.

What do you value about conversations where both people really show up as themselves?
